gate_definition: Confirm the exact Phase-1 configuration and revision before using any geometry row.
evidence_required: Reviewed source file path revision and configuration name.

gate_definition: Define envelope units primary datum secondary datum and measurement method.
evidence_required: Reviewed drawing table or measured template record.
stop_condition: Stop before fixture stock or body envelope release.

gate_definition: Define top shell stack and material-thickness measurement method.
evidence_required: Measured stock record plus reviewed CAD/drawing source.
stop_condition: Stop before slot-depth or stiffness claims.

gate_definition: Define slit width end radius root gap and edge-condition checks.
evidence_required: Kerf coupon plan and reviewed geometry source.
stop_condition: Stop before DXF/CAM export or stress-relief claims.

gate_definition: Define one tongue ID per planned tongue and bind it to geometry and tuning records.
evidence_required: Reviewed tongue layout table; no values until measured/reviewed.
stop_condition: Stop before target-note or tuning-frequency assignment.

gate_definition: Define material batch orientation moisture and density evidence needed by the model.
evidence_required: Shop stock record and measurement method.
stop_condition: Stop before applying acoustic constants or correction factors.

gate_definition: Define the review checklist required to promote one geometry row to fabrication authority.
evidence_required: Signed or dated review note plus linked evidence artifacts.
stop_condition: Stop if any row remains concept-only or unreviewed.
